name: Season 4 Recall
creator: venquis
description:
This mod restores the Season 4 Recall VFX. This mod currently only replaces the regular Recall on Summoner's Rift.



![Preview](https://i.ibb.co/1GXtmJRh/S4-Recall-Preview.gif)



*The mod includes the old Recall sound as it was updated during Season 4. To revert back to the updated (current) sound, go to Edit this mod -> Files -> Delete Common.wad.client.*
